title: Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations: integration with DSPM, Defender XDR and Insider Risk Management
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts, billing requirements, permissions and documented control paths are supported. Two checklist steps refer to controls missing from the table; these are minor presentation gaps, not reasons to withhold publication.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to incorporate DSI insights into DSPM to support sensitive-content exfiltration prevention.
claims.quote: Data Security Investigations (DSI) insights are now being incorporated into Data Security Posture Management to support the prevention of sensitive content exfiltration.

claims.claim: DSI integration with Defender XDR is being enhanced.
claims.quote: Additionally, DSI integrations with Defender XDR and Insider Risk Management are being enhanced

claims.claim: DSI integration with Insider Risk Management is being enhanced.
claims.quote: Additionally, DSI integrations with Defender XDR and Insider Risk Management are being enhanced

claims.claim: The enhancements reflect feedback from the Public Preview.
claims.quote: reflecting customer feedback received during the Public Preview phase.

claims.claim: The roadmap description supplies no further detail about the Defender XDR or Insider Risk Management changes.
claims.quote: Additionally, DSI integrations with Defender XDR and Insider Risk Management are being enhanced, reflecting customer feedback received during the Public Preview phase.

claims.claim: The Prevent exfiltration to risky destinations objective supports manual investigation creation.

claims.where: What's changing; summary; controls[0].note; Scope; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The DSPM proactive AI insights capability is documented as preview.
claims.quote: Proactive AI insights (preview): Enable an opt-in toggle

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: The documented proactive AI insights toggle is opt-in.
claims.quote: Proactive AI insights (preview): Enable an opt-in toggle that automatically creates and refreshes a single investigation for your tenant every 24 hours.

claims.claim: Enabling the toggle automatically creates a single investigation for the tenant.
claims.quote: Enable an opt-in toggle that automatically creates and refreshes a single investigation for your tenant every 24 hours.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; controls[0].governs; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The proactive investigation refreshes automatically every 24 hours while enabled.
claims.quote: The investigation refreshes automatically every 24 hours while the toggle remains enabled.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Open questions
claims.claim: The proactive investigation uses five fixed categories: credentials and access information, personally identifiable information, financial information, confidential information and intellectual property.
claims.quote: five fixed risk categories: credentials and access information, personally identifiable information (PII), financial information, confidential information, and intellectual property (IP).

claims.claim: DSPM investigations scope to all sensitive data exfiltrated from the organisation in the last 30 days.
claims.quote: Investigations created from DSPM automatically scope to all sensitive data exfiltrated from your organization in the last 30 days.

claims.claim: Learn documents investigation creation from Defender XDR incidents in the Microsoft Defender portal.
claims.quote: You can create an investigation from Defender XDR incidents containing mailbox, email message, or file nodes.

claims.claim: Learn documents investigation creation from Insider Risk Management cases.
claims.quote: With the integration of Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management, you can quickly open an investigation in Data Security Investigations from a case

claims.claim: Learn does not identify which documented incident and case creation steps constitute the roadmap enhancements.
claims.quote: Searched: 518226 Data Security Investigations DSPM Defender Insider Risk enhancements default rollout. Read Learn's DSI overview and investigation-creation page; results describe integrations without identifying the roadmap enhancements.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the arrival default for the roadmap's integration enhancements, so defaultState is unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: 518226 Data Security Investigations DSPM Defender Insider Risk enhancements default rollout. Read roadmap, DSI overview, investigation and get-started pages: an opt-in proactive toggle is documented, but no arrival default for the unspecified enhancements.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; Scope
claims.claim: Analysts can perform AI-powered content analysis on investigations created from DSPM in Purview.
claims.quote: These investigations enable deeper, AI-powered content analysis of recently exfiltrated data, giving security teams actionable insights without extra configuration.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; cost; summary; rationale: cost
claims.claim: DSI uses consumption billing, making consumption the licensing model and variable the cost rating.
claims.quote: it uses pay-as-you-go and capacity billing models. This billing structure means you pay for the storage and AI capacity features you use in the solution.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: DSI billing is based on stored data and AI capacity rather than a dedicated enterprise plan or licence, and DSI does not need such a dedicated licence.
claims.quote: However, you don't need a dedicated enterprise plan or license to use Data Security Investigations.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: DSPM lists a supporting licence for the solution as a prerequisite.
claims.quote: You have a supporting license for this Microsoft Purview solution, and your region is supported.

claims.claim: The DSPM prerequisites direct readers to the Microsoft Purview service description for licensing details.
claims.quote: You have a supporting license for this Microsoft Purview solution, and your region is supported. For more information, see the Microsoft Purview service description.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: DSI storage is pay-as-you-go, measured in GB per month.
claims.quote: The storage meter for Data Security Investigations uses the pay-as-you-go billing model. You pay for storage on a gigabyte (GB) per month basis

claims.claim: The storage meter covers data associated with all investigations in the organisation.
claims.quote: for stored data associated with all investigations in your organization.

claims.claim: Storage charges start when items are added to the investigation scope.
claims.quote: Data storage charges start when you add items to the scope of an investigation.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: AI analysis capacity is pay-as-you-go, measured in compute units.
claims.quote: Data Security Investigations uses the pay-as-you-go billing model for AI capacity. You need compute units for deep analysis and AI-related processing in your investigations. You pay only for the compute units you use.

claims.claim: Pay-as-you-go charges are billed through an Azure subscription.
claims.quote: The billing mechanisms are Azure based, so you must associate your Microsoft 365 tenant with an active Azure subscription.

claims.claim: The billing page links to the Azure Purview pricing page for storage rates.
claims.quote: For more data storage rates and pricing, see Data Security Investigations storage meter pricing.

claims.where: Why it matters; Cost and licensing; controls[0].note; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The proactive investigation continuously consumes storage and incurs ongoing storage charges while enabled.
claims.quote: Investigations auto-created by proactive AI insights from DSPM consume storage continuously while the toggle is enabled. Because the investigation refreshes every 24 hours, storage charges are ongoing.

claims.where: Why it matters; Cost and licensing; controls[0].note; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Each 24-hour proactive refresh consumes AI compute units.
claims.quote: Proactive AI insights from DSPM also consume compute units. Each 24-hour refresh cycle uses compute units to generate AI insights across five fixed risk categories.

claims.claim: Both billing models must be configured before investigations can be used and analysed.
claims.quote: Before you can use Data Security Investigations in your organization, you must configure both billing models.

claims.claim: A manual DSPM investigation can be created before DSI configuration, but configuration is needed to view it.
claims.quote: If you didn't configure Data Security Investigations before creating the investigation, the investigation is created but you need to configure Data Security Investigations before you can view the investigation.

claims.claim: Microsoft advises configuring billing before enabling proactive AI insights because the auto-created investigation incurs costs immediately.
claims.quote: configure billing before enabling the toggle because the auto-created investigation incurs storage and AI costs immediately.

claims.claim: Compute-unit processing locations can be selected from ANZ, EU, UK or US.
claims.quote: You can choose where to use compute units from any of the following locations: Australia/New Zealand (ANZ); Europe (EU); United Kingdom (UK); United States (US)

claims.claim: Administrators can opt into provisioning and AI analysis processing anywhere in the world.
claims.quote: You can opt in to having compute units provisioned and AI analysis processing done anywhere in the world to mitigate potential disruptions in case your primary location experiences high activity.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Scope; controls[1].governs; Governance controls
claims.claim: DSI Admins, Investigators and Reviewers role groups govern access and investigation tasks.
claims.quote: Actions | Data Security Investigations Admins | Data Security Investigations Investigators | Data Security Investigations Reviewers

claims.claim: Global administrators also need assignment to a listed DSI role group to create and access investigations.
claims.quote: Global admins must be assigned to one of the listed role groups for Data Security Investigations to create and access investigations.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Scope; controls[1].note; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The DSI permissions page gives Compliance Administrator full administrative access.
claims.quote: Compliance Administrator | Data Security Investigation Admin | Full administrative access

claims.claim: Organization Management has DSI administrative and contributor access.
claims.quote: Organization Management | Data Security Investigation Admin, Data Security Investigation Contributor | Administrative and contributor access

claims.claim: The get-started page describes both Compliance Administrator and Organization Management as having administrative and contributor access.
claims.quote: Members of the Compliance Administrator and Organization Management role groups automatically have Data Security Investigations administrative and contributor access.

claims.claim: Configuring AI capacity requires membership of Data Security Investigations Admins.
claims.quote: To configure the AI capacity for Data Security Investigations, you must be a member of the Data Security Investigations Admins role group.

claims.claim: Billing configuration lists Global Administrator as a prerequisite.
claims.quote: To configure the storage meter and capacity for Data Security Investigations, you must have: ... The Global Administrator role.

claims.claim: Billing configuration requires resource group Owner or Contributor.
claims.quote: The resource group Owner or Contributor role.

claims.claim: The Azure subscription must be in the same tenant as Microsoft Purview.
claims.quote: An Azure subscription in the same tenant as Microsoft Purview.

claims.claim: Billing configuration requires an Azure resource group in that subscription.
claims.quote: An Azure resource group in that subscription.

claims.claim: DSI activities are automatically recorded in the unified audit log.
claims.quote: To meet these requirements, Data Security Investigations activities are automatically logged in the unified audit log.

claims.claim: DSI supports soft purge and hard purge to remove or permanently delete items from source locations.
claims.quote: Data Security Investigations supports soft purge and hard purge options to remove or permanently delete items from data sources.

claims.claim: Purge queries can be run within an existing investigation, including a DSPM investigation using DSI capabilities.
claims.quote: Select an investigation or select Create investigation to create a new investigation. ... Purging removes items from their original source locations but doesn't remove items from the investigation scope in Data Security Investigations.

claims.claim: DSI Admins and Investigators can create and run purge queries.
claims.quote: Create and run purge queries | Yes | Yes | No

claims.claim: Soft purge supports only Exchange mailbox items.
claims.quote: Soft purge is only supported for Exchange mailbox items. Teams messages and OneDrive and SharePoint files aren't supported for soft purge.

claims.claim: Hard purge supports Exchange mailbox items and Teams messages.
claims.quote: Supported data sources | Exchange mailbox items only. | Exchange mailbox items and Teams messages.

claims.claim: Holds and retention policies preserve purged items until the hold is removed or retention expires.
claims.quote: If items are subject to a hold or retention policy, purged items are preserved in the recoverable items folder and can't be permanently deleted until the hold is removed or the retention period expires.

claims.claim: A DSI creation banner automatically appears on Defender XDR incidents that might contain sensitive information.
claims.quote: Select Create investigation from the Data Security Investigations banner at the top of any incident in Defender XDR. This banner automatically displays if the incident might contain sensitive information.

claims.claim: Custom category templates are unsupported in the proactive investigation preview.
claims.quote: In the current preview, proactive AI insights use five fixed risk categories. Custom category templates and per-item deletion within the auto-created investigation aren't supported.

claims.claim: Per-item deletion within the auto-created investigation is unsupported.
claims.quote: Custom category templates and per-item deletion within the auto-created investigation aren't supported.

claims.claim: Defender XDR incident investigations with more than approximately 3,000 items may return incomplete results.
claims.quote: Investigations created from Defender XDR incidents that contain more than approximately 3,000 items might not return complete results.

claims.claim: Insider Risk Management case investigations with more than approximately 3,000 items may return incomplete results.
claims.quote: Investigations created from Insider Risk Management cases that contain more than approximately 3,000 items might not return complete results.

claims.claim: An investigation cannot mix mailbox scope with files or email messages.
claims.quote: You can't include mailboxes in the scope of an investigation and also include files or email messages.

claims.claim: Security Administrator is listed among roles required for investigation creation in the Microsoft Defender portal.
claims.quote: To create investigations in Data Security Investigations in the Microsoft Defender portal, you must have the following roles assigned: Security Administrator; Security Operator

claims.claim: Security Operator is listed among roles required for investigation creation in the Microsoft Defender portal.
claims.quote: To create investigations in Data Security Investigations in the Microsoft Defender portal, you must have the following roles assigned: Security Administrator; Security Operator

claims.claim: Creating an investigation from an Insider Risk Management case requires Insider Risk Management or Insider Risk Management Investigator.
claims.quote: you must have at least one of the following roles assigned: Insider Risk Management; Insider Risk Management Investigator

claims.claim: The DSPM permissions table lists six additional role groups for creating data security investigations.
claims.quote: Compliance Administrator; Data Security Management; Insider Risk Management Admin; Organization Management; Data Security Investigations Admin; Data Security Investigations Investigator

claims.claim: The DSPM activity table marks Microsoft Entra Global Administrator as unsupported for creating a data security investigation.
claims.quote: Create data security investigation | ✕ | ✕ | ✕ | ✕ | ✕

claims.claim: The DSPM activity table marks Microsoft Entra Compliance Administrator as unsupported for creating a data security investigation.
claims.quote: Create data security investigation | ✕ | ✕ | ✕ | ✕ | ✕

claims.claim: The DSPM table marks the Purview Compliance Administrator column unsupported, despite listing Compliance Administrator among additional groups.
claims.quote: Create data security investigation | ✕ | ✕ | ✕ | ✕ | ✕ | Compliance Administrator

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends using the in-product cost estimator.
claims.quote: Use the in-product cost estimator before starting investigations

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends Azure budgets at DSI resource group and meter level.
claims.quote: Use built-in spending controls in Azure ... Create budgets for the Data Security Investigations resource group and meter level.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends alerts at spending thresholds such as 50%, 75% or 90%.
claims.quote: Configure alerts when spending approaches defined thresholds (for example, 50%, 75%, or 90%).

claims.claim: The billing page describes budgets and alerts rather than stating that use stops at a threshold.
claims.quote: Create budgets for the Data Security Investigations resource group and meter level. Configure alerts when spending approaches defined thresholds (for example, 50%, 75%, or 90%).

claims.claim: Deleting an investigation stops paying for its associated storage.
claims.quote: When you delete an investigation, you stop paying for the associated data storage amount. The charges are prorated to the number of days the data was stored in the billing cycle.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; controls[3].governs; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The Pay-as-you-go usage dashboard reports storage and compute units per investigation rather than setting a limit.
claims.quote: Use the Pay-as-you-go usage dashboard to quickly view and track data storage and compute unit usage for each investigation in your organization.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; controls[3].note; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The latest billing data may take up to 48 hours to appear.
claims.quote: It might take up to 48 hours for the latest billing data to show up on the Pay-as-you-go usage dashboard for your organization.

claims.claim: Only DSI Admin role holders can access the usage dashboard.
claims.quote: Only users assigned the Data Security Investigations Admin role can access the Pay-as-you-go usage dashboard.

claims.claim: Stopping DSI billing requires disabling storage and AI capacity and deletes all investigations.
claims.quote: To stop billing for Data Security Investigations, disable both storage meter and AI capacity support. This action deletes all investigations in Data Security Investigations

claims.claim: Stopping billing also deletes DSI compute-unit capacity.
claims.quote: This action deletes all investigations in Data Security Investigations and deletes compute units for your resource group.

claims.claim: The deletion involved in stopping billing is irreversible.
claims.quote: Deleting investigations and your compute unit resource group is irreversible.

claims.claim: Microsoft advises exporting or preserving investigation results before stopping billing.
claims.quote: Make sure you export or preserve any investigation results or reports before stopping billing.

claims.claim: Microsoft advises keeping at least one member in the DSI Admins role group.
claims.quote: Always have at least one user in the Data Security Investigations Admins role group so that your Data Security Investigations configuration doesn't get in to a 'zero administrator' scenario

claims.claim: The proactive toggle is at Purview > DSPM (preview) > Objectives > Prevent exfiltration to risky destinations > View objective > Exfiltration risk patterns > Proactive AI insights.
claims.quote: go to DSPM (preview). In Objectives, select the Prevent exfiltration to risky destinations card. Select View objective ... On the Exfiltration risk patterns card, turn on the Proactive AI insights toggle.

claims.claim: DSI role membership can be assigned at Purview > Settings > Roles and groups > Role groups > role group > Edit > Choose users.

claims.claim: Add-RoleGroupMember -Identity "<role-group>" -Member "<user-UPN>" adds a user to a role group using the documented Exchange PowerShell command.
claims.quote: Use the Add-RoleGroupMember cmdlet to add members to a management role group. ... The Identity parameter specifies the role group to add a member to. ... User ID or user principal name (UPN)

claims.claim: Storage billing setup is at Purview > Data Security Investigations > Setup tasks > Setup pay-as-you-go-billing for data storage.
claims.quote: Go to Data Security Investigations ... in the Microsoft Purview portal ... Select Setup pay-as-you-go-billing for data storage in the Setup tasks section.

claims.claim: No DSI billing-setup or AI-capacity-setup API, PowerShell or Graph operation is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Data Security Investigations billing setup compute units REST API PowerShell Microsoft Graph; Data Security Investigations billing Microsoft.Graph beta PowerShell. Read DSI billing, Purview billing models and Graph beta security reference; no DSI setup operation found.

claims.claim: The usage dashboard is at Purview > Data Security Investigations > Usage dashboard.
claims.quote: Go to Data Security Investigations ... in the Microsoft Purview portal ... Select Usage dashboard in the left-navigation.

claims.claim: No API, PowerShell or Graph operation for the DSI usage dashboard is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Data Security Investigations usage dashboard API PowerShell Graph; Data Security Investigations usage API beta. Read DSI billing dashboard section and Graph beta security reference, searched reference for DSI and usage dashboard; no operation found.

claims.claim: AI capacity uses the separate Set up AI capacity task in the DSI Setup tasks section.
claims.quote: Go to Data Security Investigations ... Select Set up AI capacity in the Setup tasks section.

claims.claim: The DSI permissions page gives portal assignment steps, not a PowerShell command.
claims.quote: Searched: Data Security Investigations billing Microsoft.Graph beta PowerShell; Proactive AI insights API PowerShell Security & Compliance. Read the full DSI permissions page and Add-RoleGroupMember reference: portal steps on the former, the general cmdlet on the latter.
